body:
Thank you for the careful replay and review. Answers to the three questions:

1. **Wall clearance.** That was my error in the report. 8.2e-13 (8.165e-13) is the least wall clearance of an earlier, slightly larger 303 certificate from the same search (side 17.909763172478, not submitted), and I copied its figure into the issue by mistake. On `s303_amund.cert` at `511f56b`, `verify_cert.py` prints `min wall clearance = 6.020e-13 (square #3)`, as you measured.
2. **Tangents.** Yes: the certificate was made with `search/packer/dilate_cert.py` at evand/square-packing `7982d7a9346e29e36cab3ce075274f3023114353`, from `s303_amund.input.txt` (the same bytes as in the gist), on macOS 26 arm64 with Python 3.14.6, so `math.tan` is Apple's libm; that explains a last-place difference against a Linux replay. The only edit afterwards was to the comment line (a local path removed).
3. **Retention.** Yes, please keep both files. I dedicate `s303_amund.cert`, `s303_amund.input.txt` and the README in gist `78f9f0e7…` to the public domain under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). The same applies to every certificate, input packing and README in the gist of #798 (`amundsk/e4df936fb09c68446598d4c8309d0166`, revision `c9be7b70e2220c2eccb2c5ea746094bc85dda405`).
